  "phoneNote": "The oversized hero card leaves mostly cropped foliage visible, hiding the restaurant’s character until much farther down the page.",
  "desktopNote": "The photography and burgundy-and-gold palette feel appropriate, but repeated contact and opening-hours blocks make the lower page unnecessarily repetitive.",

  },
  "fixes": [
    "Consolidate reservations, address, directions and opening hours into one practical contact section; keep the footer for legal details and secondary navigation.",
    "On phones, use a separately cropped hero photo that clearly shows the restaurant or terrace, and shorten the text card so the venue remains visible in the first screen.",
    "Reduce the desktop founding-year numeral and opening-hours heading, and tighten their surrounding whitespace to give practical information a more balanced visual weight."
  ],
  "blockers": [
    "Phone and desktop: the lower contact area repeats the address and directions block, while the footer repeats the opening-hours block already shown above."
  ]
}
